baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from أَسَرَّ through نَبَّأَتْ and أَظْهَرَهُ culminates in عَرَّفَ بَعْضَهُ وَأَعْرَضَ عَن بَعْضٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A concealed utterance enters a relay, is made manifest, and is then deliberately divided: one portion is marked for acknowledgment while another is passed over. Exposure restores knowledge without requiring exhaustive publication.

activation_trace.role: The hidden-interior image supplies the initial enclosure from which the utterance escapes.
The arriving, delivered report supplies the repeated handoffs and the explicit question about provenance.
Partition into portions governs both the relational channel and the unequal treatment of the disclosed content.
Emergence from concealment supplies the divine transition from hidden event to knowable event.
Recognition through a distinguishing trace makes the acknowledged portion specifically identifiable rather than generally exposed.
Turning one's side supplies an intentional non-pursuit of the remaining portion.

changed_reading.before: A confidence is betrayed, discovered, and confronted.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages controlled disclosure: divine exposure repairs an epistemic imbalance, while the human response partitions what must be named from what can be passed over.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَسَرَّ, حَدِيثًا, and أَظْهَرَهُ place concealment, newly occurring speech, and manifestation in one short circuit.
baseline_models.mechanism: Several focus branches make hidden and shown states internally reversible: أَسَرَّ has a disputed manifestation branch, حَدِيث can be an event newly brought about or something displayed, and ظ ه ر can turn an affair from back to belly. The utterance does not merely travel unchanged; its circulation changes its ontological and social state.

activation_trace.role: The disputed image of showing what is called secret installs manifestation inside the act of concealment itself.
Coming into being after nonbeing treats the utterance as a fresh event produced by being spoken.
Bringing something out or displaying it makes the حديث itself a latent disclosure mechanism.
Turning an affair back-to-belly supplies the inside-out reversal from private speech to exposed relation.

changed_reading.before: A fixed piece of information moves from one knower to another.
changed_reading.after: Speech becomes a state-changing event: concealment already bears a possibility of display, and relay turns the private interior of the relation outward.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root ن ب ء occurs in the prophet-title and four acts of informing, while the closing answer names ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated notification root links ordinary report, the prophetic office, the wife's source-question, and divine disclosure, but the final علم/خبر pair ranks these channels: delivered news is nested under knowledge that opens the thing to the knower and expertise in its interior.

activation_trace.role: The useful report arriving through transmission supplies the human information chain.
The one who reports from God distinguishes prophetic notification from the surrounding human relays.
Voiced saying makes the source-question and answer the point where competing channels are explicitly compared.
The thing becoming uncovered to a knower supplies comprehensive epistemic access.
Knowledge of report and inward condition supplies access deeper than secondhand narration.

changed_reading.before: The closing exchange merely identifies who leaked the information.
changed_reading.after: The exchange adjudicates kinds of knowing: human reports circulate, prophetic notification receives, and divine knowledge encompasses both the report and its hidden interior.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The concealed حديث is directed إِلَى بَعْضِ أَزْوَاجِهِ, placing transmission inside a paired marital channel before it spreads.
baseline_models.mechanism: Pairing creates a privileged two-sided channel, and the marriage-secret branch sharpens its intimacy. The three occurrences of بعض then nest partiality inside partiality: one member of a plural household receives one communication, and only some of that communication is later named.

activation_trace.role: One counterpart joined to another supplies the two-sided architecture of privileged communication.
The marriage partner fixes that paired channel inside a bond with special expectations of confidence.
The hidden marriage-secret image intensifies the utterance as material internal to conjugal intimacy.
Renewed conversational report supplies the speech that should remain within, but instead extends beyond, the pair.
Repeated portioning creates nested limits on recipient, content, acknowledgment, and omission.

changed_reading.before: The ayah recounts generic gossip within a household.
changed_reading.after: The relay deforms a deliberately paired channel: the offense is not only that news travels, but that speech addressed within a two-sided bond is rerouted beyond it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding movement from prohibition to prescribed release of an oath makes the focus disclosure resemble bounded untying. The threefold بعض and the عرف/أعرض split loosen what has become knotted in the relation without tearing every covering away.

activation_trace.role: Partition into portions anchors the proposed boundedness directly in the focus response.
Turning aside supplies the restraint that keeps untying from becoming exhaustive exposure.
Prohibition and prevention supply the self-imposed binding immediately before the focus event.
Untying a knot supplies the material action by which selective truth can reopen a bound relation.
Release from an oath fixes that untying in the packet's explicit juridical-relational sequence.
A precisely bounded obligation supplies a limit and measure to the release rather than a general cancellation.
The oath image supplies the binding speech-act whose sanctioned release precedes the leaked speech-act.

structural_cues: 66:1 places prohibition and permission immediately before 66:2's prescribed oath-release.
66:3 answers a total leak with the asymmetrical pair عَرَّفَ بَعْضَهُ / أَعْرَضَ عَن بَعْضٍ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prohibition, oath, measured obligation, and knot-release; I infer that selective disclosure performs an analogous bounded untying in the relationship. A live alternative is that the legal sequence only frames the domestic event and does not model its repair.

changed_reading.before: Selective confrontation is simply merciful restraint after a leak.
changed_reading.after: Enough truth is disclosed to undo a binding distortion, while enough is passed over to preserve the relation from being torn open wholesale.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following dual address names inclined hearts and the possibility of mutual backing. This converts the focus relay into a diagnostic event: the movement of speech makes a direction of listening and loyalty visible, and potential alliance turns an apparently private leak into relational topology.

activation_trace.role: Movement from place to place turns notification into a trace of where speech, attention, and allegiance travel.
Inclination of heart and loyalty supplies the hidden direction that the relay renders observable.
Bending the ear toward a speaker supplies an auditory mechanism joining reception of confidence to directional allegiance.
The heart supplies the interior site whose orientation is diagnosed rather than merely the organ of private feeling.
Turning a thing from its face supplies the possibility that the relay manifests an already reversed orientation.
Taking strength from another's back supplies the mutual-support structure latent behind the two-person disclosure.

structural_cues: The singular recipient of 66:3 is followed by dual verbs and dual hearts in 66:4.
66:4 offers two opposed continuations: return, or mutually reinforce against him.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heart-tilt, ear-tilt, and mutual backing; I infer that the leaked report reveals or consolidates an alignment rather than merely violating privacy. A live alternative is that 66:4 names a moral condition independently of the report's path.

changed_reading.before: The leak is an isolated lapse by one recipient.
changed_reading.after: The leak is a diagnostic path: where the report travels discloses where hearts and ears lean and whether a private channel is becoming a two-person alliance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The household-protection command and its fire/fuel/stone material field activate a propagation model. Once intimate speech becomes combustible social material, naming some and turning from some can function as a firebreak: enough exposure to stop hidden spread, enough restraint to avoid feeding escalation.

activation_trace.role: Partition supplies the break that interrupts total propagation.
Deliberate turning aside supplies refusal to keep adding material to the conflict.
Protection that repels harm supplies the purpose of the proposed informational boundary.
The group of nearness and belonging fixes the threatened field as the household relation rather than an abstract public.
Kindled fire supplies the spreading destructive process used as the material analogy.
Fuel as consumable fire-material lets repeated speech be modeled as what keeps escalation burning.
Hard stone supplies the resistant material endpoint of a conflict no longer responsive to ordinary softening.

structural_cues: 66:6 addresses protection of both selves and أهل, extending responsibility through the same intimate social boundary at issue in 66:3.
The focus itself stops the relay's reenactment by reporting no content and by explicitly leaving a portion unpursued.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies household protection, fire, fuel, and stone; I supply the arrow that circulating speech can feed escalation and that partial disclosure interrupts it. A live alternative is that the fire field is solely eschatological and does not model the focus conversation.

changed_reading.before: Passing over part of the offense is interpersonal forbearance.
changed_reading.after: Passing over part can also be containment: a selective firebreak that exposes the dangerous circuit without supplying it more fuel.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence combines sincere repair, stitching a tear, light moving ahead, connection between positions, and completion. It revises divine manifestation in the focus from punitive spotlight to mobile reparative illumination: selective naming can be the stitch through which truth crosses a torn relation without enlarging the tear.

activation_trace.role: Emergence and disclosure anchor the light model in the focus's divine making-visible.
A distinguishing sign supplies focused illumination that marks what needs recognition rather than exposing everything.
Purity from mixture or fraud supplies the truth-quality required for disclosure to repair.
Sewing a tear supplies the concrete reparative action assigned to selective acknowledgment.
Illumination supplies a non-destructive mode of making hidden relations visible.
Purposeful movement toward an end makes the light active and directional rather than a static glare.
A connection maintained between endpoints supplies the relational span across which reparative truth travels.
The between-the-hands image places illumination immediately before the agents as guidance for their next act.
Arrival at completion supplies repair as the end toward which partial illumination moves.

structural_cues: 66:8 twice names light and asks for its completion, so revelation is represented as progressive rather than all-at-once.
66:3 likewise moves through stages: concealment, relay, manifestation, selective recognition, and selective passing-over.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pure repentance, stitching, moving light, relational connection, and completion; I infer that the focus's selective disclosure can be a reparative illumination. A live alternative is that the light belongs only to final vindication and does not redescribe domestic disclosure.

changed_reading.before: God's manifestation exposes wrongdoing so it can be confronted.
changed_reading.after: God's manifestation can also be read as measured light for repair: it identifies the tear, carries truth across it, and permits completion without widening it through total exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired wife-examples separate marital proximity from fidelity and sufficiency; the next wife asks for a newly built home near God and rescue by separation. Together they turn زوج in the focus from a guaranteed confidential enclosure into a contingent structure whose joins must be made trustworthy.

activation_trace.role: Joined counterparts supply the relational architecture whose integrity is being tested.
Deficiency in fidelity and trust supplies the failure mode for a bond that remains outwardly proximate.
Sufficiency supplies the denied assumption that one spouse's standing can compensate for the other's breach.
Building by joining parts supplies an alternative household whose coherence must be constructed rather than presumed.
The marriage-house image keeps the request for another home in dialogue with the focus's damaged conjugal channel.
Rescue by separation supplies the possibility that moral and epistemic allegiance may require distance from an existing household order.

structural_cues: 66:10 presents two wives under righteous husbands; 66:11 reverses the arrangement with one believing wife inside a corrupt household.
The paired examples test belonging by response and fidelity, not by physical or marital proximity alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed fidelity, failed spousal sufficiency, a newly built home, and rescue by separation; I infer that the focus leak tests whether pairing actually carries trust. A live alternative is that 66:10-11 concern individual accountability without commenting on the information channel in 66:3.

changed_reading.before: A spouse violates an otherwise secure marital confidence.
changed_reading.after: The episode tests the pair itself: marital nearness creates a channel but cannot guarantee fidelity, moral alignment, or the sufficiency of one partner for the other.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final ayah combines guarded enclosure, an opening, incoming breath, life, truthful confirmation, linking speech, and fixed writing. This activates a membrane rather than a wall: integrity depends not on absolute impermeability but on whether passage is authorized, truth-bearing, and life-producing. The focus then distinguishes illicit rerouting from divine disclosure rather than treating every crossing of secrecy as the same act.

activation_trace.role: A hidden interior supplies the protected inside whose boundary is at issue.
A report arriving through transmission supplies the crossing that must be ethically differentiated.
Preservation inside an encompassing fortress supplies integrity as active guarding.
An opening between two sides supplies the aperture through which a guarded interior can nevertheless receive.
Sending breath into something supplies authorized inward transmission rather than uncontrolled leakage outward.
Life-giving spirit supplies the generative result by which a legitimate passage is distinguished.
Truthfulness of speech supplies the fidelity criterion for what crosses the boundary.
Intelligible utterance linking speakers supplies communication as connection rather than mere escape of content.
A fixed inscription that establishes judgment supplies authorization and stable norm for transmission.

structural_cues: 66:12 preserves both enclosure and entry: guarding is followed by a divinely initiated passage through it.
66:3 likewise contrasts two transmissions by source and direction: a confidence relayed outward and knowledge disclosed from God to the prophet.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fortification, aperture, incoming breath, life, truthful speech, and binding word; I infer an ethics of authorized passage and use it to differentiate the two disclosure directions in 66:3. A live alternative is that the corporeal-generative sequence should not be transferred to domestic speech at all.

changed_reading.before: Secrecy protects integrity, while disclosure breaches it.
changed_reading.after: Integrity behaves like a guarded membrane: unauthorized rerouting can betray it, while authorized, truthful disclosure can cross the boundary to restore knowledge and life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the arrow that turns aside without scratching is remote from ordinary notification. It remains anchored in the five focus occurrences of ن ب ء, the repeated portions, and explicit turning-away; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for restraint, never as the lexical meaning of نَبَّأَهَا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The prophet informs her of the matter but acknowledges only some and turns away from some.

activation_trace.role: The arrow that deviates and does not wound supplies an image of notification deliberately aimed away from maximal injury.
Division into portions supplies the reduced target of the informing act.
Turning one's side supplies the visible deflection that keeps confrontation from striking every available point.

changed_reading.before: Informing her is the direct delivery of an accusation.
changed_reading.after: The informing can be carried as a deliberately deflected shot: accurate enough to register the breach, but partitioned and turned aside so it does not maximize the wound.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation uses the packet's non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping, so it is form-distant and cannot be rendered as a gloss of قال. It remains valid as a split-root activation because the verse itself minimizes speech through some/some and a two-line question-answer; downstream prose should label it an economy-of-speech resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The only direct dialogue is the compact قالت/قال exchange, surrounded by عرّف بعضه وأعرض عن بعض.

activation_trace.role: Voiced saying supplies the literal question-and-answer exchange.
Smallness and scarcity from the split mapping supply an exploratory pressure toward saying only what is needed.
Portioning supplies the focus syntax that makes scarcity of speech functionally visible.

changed_reading.before: The dialogue closes the scene by answering a source-question.
changed_reading.after: The dialogue also enacts disciplined scarcity: a minimal question receives a minimal source-answer after the offense itself has been only partly voiced.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The hidden-lunar-phase branch is a cross-domain image, not a claim about the utterance's dictionary sense. It remains anchored by the explicit concealment-to-manifestation sequence and the partial visibility of بعض; downstream prose should qualify it as a temporal-spatial analogy for phased disclosure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A hidden utterance becomes manifest, yet only some of it is brought into explicit recognition.

activation_trace.role: The moon's concealment at the month's end supplies a phase of invisibility rather than permanent absence.
Emergence and visibility supply the next phase after hiddenness.
Portioning supplies crescent-like partial visibility rather than a binary switch to total exposure.

changed_reading.before: The secret is hidden and then exposed.
changed_reading.after: The secret passes through phases: hidden, surfaced, and only partially made explicit, so manifestation need not abolish every remaining interior.

strongest_changes: The focus moves from a leak-and-confrontation story to a model of bounded disclosure that names what repairs knowledge and deliberately leaves the rest unamplified.
The following dual-heart and mutual-backing language makes the report's path diagnostic of inclination and alliance.
Later household, light, fidelity, and guarded-opening fields keep several mechanisms alive: firebreak, reparative illumination, contingent pairing, and authorized passage.
summary.what_was_special: The dense recurrence of ن ب ء and بعض, together with the exact عرف/أعرض asymmetry, made information flow itself the focus mechanism. Context did not settle one moral; it changed the same selective disclosure into juridical untying, alliance detection, containment, repair, a test of pairing, and a membrane ethics.
remaining_uncertainties: The arrows from selective disclosure to relational repair or conflict containment are abductive; the packet supplies the materials but not those causal directions.
The arrow, lunar, and ق و ل/ق ل ل scarcity activations are deliberately branch-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The later examples may frame accountability without directly modeling the domestic information circuit, so the contextual readings should coexist rather than displace the focus-only baselines.
